comparison.objective: Take an ear temperature by seating and holding a probe through measurement; candidate rejects open cartons on a moving line.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1912 tests constrained anatomical insertion, button actuation and sub-millimetric pose holding. Candidate tests tracking, broad opposed grasping, flap avoidance and level transport.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1912 requires correct seating, a valid 3 s reading, safe insertion depth and released laydown; excessive depth or dropping permanently zeros the trial. Candidate grades carton rejection/pass status and content preservation.
comparison.reason: Probe seating and measurement stability test a different contact-control ability than loaded-carton handling.
